name: Hanayori Sayuri
source:
Sayuri is a second lieutenant of the Japanese Imperial Demon Army and a member of Guren's squad in the Moon Demon Company. While serving as a member of the Moon Demon Company, she is also an Army instructor for the training classes and as a servant for the Ichinose family.

Sayuri is cheerful, energetic, and acts like a klutz most of the time, but is strangely perceptive on a couple of occasions. She is kind, and has had a crush on Guren for a long time now; during her childhood with him, she had a crush on Guren and is his emotional support.

[From [url=http://owarinoseraph.wikia.com/wiki/Sayuri_Hanayori]Owari no Seraph Wiki[/url]]
